claims.text: In the lab, protected Đơn Hàng endpoints need an access token from Keycloak; without a token they answer 401.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: Program.cs:40-56; OrdersController [Authorize]; lab check curl GET /api/v1/orders/1 -> 401

claims.text: ApiFactory (DonHang.Tests only) registers TestAuthHandler with AddScheme under "Test" and AddAuthentication(TestAuthHandler.SchemeName) makes "Test" the default authentication scheme.
AddAuthentication(string defaultScheme) sets the default scheme, used to authenticate and challenge when an endpoint names no scheme.
claims.source_hint: aspnetcore-docs security/authentication (default scheme); test/integration-tests.md mock authentication

claims.text: TestAuthHandler builds the caller from X-Test-Subject (sub claim) and X-Test-Roles (comma-separated, one roles claim each), with nameType "sub" and roleType "roles"; the API reads sub and roles from Keycloak tokens (MapInboundClaims=false, RoleClaimType=roles).
Without X-Test-Subject, HandleAuthenticateAsync returns AuthenticateResult.NoResult(); an [Authorize] endpoint then answers 401 (PostOrder_NoCaller_Returns401 passes).
claims.source_hint: TestAuthHandler.cs:22-23; OrdersApiTests.cs:35-43; aspnetcore-docs AuthenticateResult.NoResult; verified by execution

claims.text: StaffOnly (RequireRole("staff")) on the ship endpoint is checked before the action; for GET, OrdersController.Get loads the order then calls AuthorizeAsync with the OrderOwner policy (OrderOwnerHandler). Neither names a scheme.
The API finds the calling customer by sub through customers.identity_subject (FindByIdentitySubjectAsync); OrdersApiTests.InsertCustomerAsync saves a customer with IdentitySubject = subject.
At stage-2, GetOrder_AnotherCustomersOrder_Returns403 (customer-binh reads customer-an's order) and ShipOrder_Customer_Returns403 (customer-an ships her own order) both expect 403 and pass.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: OrdersApiTests.cs:45-70; verified by execution

claims.text: These tests do not exercise AddJwtBearer's checks of signature, issuer, audience and expiry; those run only when the API validates real Keycloak tokens.
With roleType "roles" on the ClaimsIdentity, IsInRole("staff") checks the roles claims; RequireRole("staff") (StaffOnly) is satisfied through IsInRole.
TestAuthHandler is in the test project only; the lab's running API registers only AddJwtBearer, so a lab request with X-Test-Subject and no token answers 401.
claims.source_hint: git grep TestAuthHandler stage-2 (DonHang.Tests only); lab check: curl with X-Test-Subject -> 401 (scratchpad it-a/evidence-tc.txt)
